name: unsafe_masked_index_put_accumulate
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_unsafe_masked_index_put_accumulate(Tensor self, Tensor mask, Tensor?[] indices, Tensor values) -> Tensor. Tests cover the legacy multidimensional shape matrix, per-dimension index conversion, project floating dtypes except unsupported bfloat16, numerical accumulation, and non-mutation of every input.
